pattern.description: End-card lockup: the centred cube logomark glides left to make room while the 'Notion' wordmark fades in from grey to black beside it, resolving into the horizontal lockup.
pattern.why_premium: The mark moves only as far as the lockup needs, and the wordmark fades in during that move, so the logo settles in one smooth step with no bounce or extra decoration.

build_hint.gsap: Start with the mark centred (x offset = +wordmarkWidth/2) and wordmark opacity 0. tl.to(mark, {x: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.inOut'}).fromTo(wordmark, {opacity: 0, x: -20}, {opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}, '-=0.3').
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 14], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); mark translateX = (1 - p) * wordmarkWidth / 2; wordmark opacity = interpolate(frame, [5, 16], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}). Ease, not spring.

notes: Filmstrip panels are zoomed crops of different extents, so the exact mark travel and whether the wordmark also slides is uncertain; camera verdict is none, so the pan/scale sums reflect the lockup reflow, not a camera move.
